scope: One browser, ten selected files per cohort, local TLS/HTTP2 gateway to MinIO; declared overlap probe shaping; not live AWS or default HTTP/1 capacity
missing_value_policy: Unknown or incomplete measurements are JSON null / CSV blank; no fixture contents are read.

denominators.definition: A file can pass integrity in a failed cohort. Only passed complete cohorts count toward the concurrency release gate; small fixtures do not establish 500 MB outcomes.

certificate.scope: Local test CA; no host trust store changes

observer_api.transport: Native Node HTTP client, new socket per request, Connection: close, absolute15s deadline, no retries; excluded from native browser API latency population

broker.scope: Dedicated Redis database 0; default Celery queue, priority lists and Kombu unacked hash/index

resource_budgets.memory_accounting: Container cgroup hard limits are enforced by Docker. Chrome memory is the sum of process RSS and can double-count shared pages; Chrome/runner ceilings are sampled acceptance thresholds, not enforced process memory caps or instantaneous maxima. Record actual timestamps; skipped overlapping collections must be explicit.
resource_budgets.oom_policy: Fail on any own-service container OOM or increase in cgroup oom/oom_kill counters, including a killed worker pool child.

disk_budget.cleanup_policy: Keep only ten source fixtures; create a fresh ten-file workspace per run; download/hash files sequentially and delete the completed run before the next run.

time_budget.definition: Starts when the ten-file cohort is selected; includes browser hashing, scheduling, uploads, completion, queueing, and verification. This is a bounded harness deadline, not a latency SLO.
time_budget.whole_cohort_definition: Bound for the complete cohort, including download integrity checks and scoped cleanup; shared fixture generation is recorded separately.

success_invariants: Ten actual storage PUT byte-transfer intervals have a nonempty common intersection, with positive per-file upload progress and no completed file counted as active.
All ten files reach READY; each worker and independent streamed download matches source bytes and SHA-256.
Thirty fresh file IDs across three full runs; no skipped or silently rerun failed cohorts/files.
One logical file, object, and result per source; no multipart leaks, forbidden cross-workspace downloads, OOMs, unhandled5xx responses, or budget breaches.
Resource/admission settings, hardware, provider/image identities, source/manifest digests and clocks are recorded; measured source and budgets remain unchanged during scored runs.
Every attempted run remains in history. An adjusted budget requires a new manifest revision and a fresh complete scored run, with prior failures retained.
metrics_required: Browser hash time, active transfer windows, multipart completion, source selection to READY, download/hash durations, and total cohort time.
Aggregate actual-transfer throughput and end-to-end throughput with explicit denominators; per-file latency; API p50/p95 grouped by route template and measured request population.
Browser/runner RSS and per-service CPU/memory samples; actual sample timestamps; cgroup OOM counters.
Database pool/checkouts, lock/wait metrics, processing outbox backlog, active/expired claims, publications, delivery/verification attempts, and queue/backlog observations.
Network/storage errors, application retries, admission rejections, forbidden-access controls, and final scoped inventory.
non_claims: No throughput or API latency SLO is imposed; report observed values.
Local MinIO results do not establish live AWS capacity, WAN behavior, or production availability.
Ten file upload intervals alone or a start barrier do not establish simultaneous byte transfers.

scheduler_and_admission.browser_part_fairness: Reserve one global slot for each admitted active owner before granting spare slots, so ten first PUTs cannot deadlock behind greedily admitted extra part loops.

network_profile.browser_to_storage_protocol: HTTP/2 over TLS through the dedicated test gateway; record negotiated protocol for actual PUTs.
network_profile.gateway_to_minio_protocol: Streamed HTTP reverse proxy; retain the original signed Host and query.
network_profile.certificate_scope: Locally generated test certificate; browser ignores trust errors only for this isolated test context; record certificate fingerprint, never private key.
network_profile.default_profile_limitation: A single-origin HTTP/1 browser may restrict simultaneously active connections; this measured ten-stream result must not be generalized to that default profile.

overlap_probe.method: Temporary declared upload shaping only until all ten first PUTs show positive partial progress; remove shaping before any first PUT completes.
evidence_required: Shaping start/end timestamps and configured cap.
Ten distinct files with positive partial upload progress and common active transfer interval.
HTTP/2 negotiation on actual storage requests.
overlap_probe.throughput_policy: All shaping-probe time remains inside reported transfer windows. Do not call the resulting throughput unshaped provider capacity.

sampling.definition: Actual timestamps are authoritative. Chrome RSS sums may double-count shared pages. Container memory usage is Docker accounting; process RSS sums may also double-count shared pages. Docker CPU percentages use 100% per CPU core. Samples are observations, not instantaneous maxima.
sampling.scope: PG connection counts include the read-only observer. API pool metrics describe the API process only. CPU/RSS maxima are sampled; service RSS sums may double-count shared pages. OOM fields are counters, not inferred process outcomes.
